# Smart Device Platform — Agent Guide

Short entry point for coding agents. Use this file for start-up discipline only; detailed rules live in [`harness/`](harness/), project navigation lives in [`docs/INDEX.md`](docs/INDEX.md).

## Project Overview

Flutter monorepo for smart-device Apps (glasses, watches, earphones). Priority is establishing platform specs and reusable capabilities first, then incrementally delivering features and Apps.

```text
apps/              App shells, brand and App-specific logic
packages/widget/   Composite pages/components using Feature state (may depend on Feature)
packages/feature/  Complete user scenarios, grouped by domain (device/, ai/, …)
packages/common/   Shared primitives below Feature (no Feature deps)
packages/core/     Base types and cross-App/cross-platform capabilities
specs/             Capability contracts
```

Dependency direction: `App → Widget → Feature → Common → Core`. Full layer model: [`docs/architecture.md`](docs/architecture.md#layer-structure).

## Fact Priority

When conflicts arise, follow the authority order in [`docs/INDEX.md`](docs/INDEX.md#fact-priority): code and `pubspec.yaml` first, then stable specs, then active architecture docs and ADRs, then draft/planning assets.

`app_configs/` is planning-only and does not participate in the build. `generate_app.dart` is not implemented — do not describe future generation as a current capability.

不是图片解码问题。失败发生在任何图片字节下载、缩略图生成或系统相册写入之前。

证据：

- 相册页通过 BLE 已拿到设备照片数 `6`，说明设备连接和媒体计数正常：[日志第 164-169 行](/Users/jace/.codex/attachments/5ec0a3d9-7933-44b4-8ee5-6544870facaf/pasted-text.txt:164)。
- 点击导入后，设备下发了眼镜热点 SSID 和密码：[第 187-189 行](/Users/jace/.codex/attachments/5ec0a3d9-7933-44b4-8ee5-6544870facaf/pasted-text.txt:187)。
- iOS 尝试加入该热点约 17.3 秒后超时，最终错误为 `media_transfer.ap_ssid_timed_out`：[第 205-207 行](/Users/jace/.codex/attachments/5ec0a3d9-7933-44b4-8ee5-6544870facaf/pasted-text.txt:205)。

相册进入时只走 BLE 文件计数；真正点击导入时，代码会先用 SDK 通过眼镜 Wi-Fi 热点/FTP 重新校验并下载，因此卡在热点关联阶段：[device_album_controller.dart](/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/feature/device/feature_device_album/lib/src/controller/device_album_controller.dart:105)。原生层也明确将此类错误归类为 `ssid_timed_out`：[CoreDeviceFileTransferPlugin.swift](/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/core/core_device_native_runtime/ios/core_device_native_runtime/Sources/core_device_native_runtime/file_transfer/CoreDeviceFileTransferPlugin.swift:339)。

优先排查：

1. 在 iPhone 系统 Wi-Fi 中手动连接眼镜下发的热点。手动也连不上，问题在眼镜热点状态、固件或射频环境。
2. 手动能连上、App 仍超时，则是 iOS 原生热点关联路径或厂商 SDK 问题；需要补 `NEHotspotConfiguration` 的提交结果、当前 SSID 和关联完成回调日志。
3. iOS 的 `NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription` 与 Hotspot Configuration entitlement 已存在，因此不像是缺少 plist/签名配置；错误类型也不是 `local_network_denied`。

另外，原始日志包含会话令牌和热点密码，建议立即作废会话并在后续日志中脱敏。
